senses.en: a law passed by a parliament or congress
senses.pattern: pass an act / an Act of Parliament / under the act
senses.example: Under the new [[act]], factories that pollute rivers will have to pay much heavier fines.
senses.example_zh: 根據這項新法案，汙染河川的工廠將必須繳納更重的罰款。
senses.note: 作法案名稱時常大寫：the Clean Air Act

senses.en: to have an effect on something
senses.pattern: act quickly / act on the brain / act on the nervous system
senses.example: The painkiller [[acts]] quickly, so most patients feel better within twenty minutes of taking it.
senses.example_zh: 這種止痛藥很快就起作用，大多數病人服用後二十分鐘內就覺得好多了。

senses.en: one of the main parts of a play
senses.pattern: Act One / the final act / a play in three acts
senses.example: The hero does not appear on stage until the second [[act]] of the play.
senses.example_zh: 主角直到這齣戲的第二幕才登場。

gsat.sentence: The earliest reference to these documents is found in a 15th-century [[Act]] of Parliament, while the term “passport” came into use about a century later.

senses.en: a hard hit; a sudden shock or disappointment
senses.pattern: a heavy blow to / deal a blow to / a blow to one's confidence / soften the blow
senses.example: Losing the school's best pitcher to injury was a serious [[blow]] to the baseball team.
senses.example_zh: 學校最好的投手因傷缺陣，對棒球隊是一大打擊。

senses.en: to waste a chance or spoil something by a mistake
senses.pattern: blow a chance / blow an interview / blow it
senses.example: He [[blew]] his chance of getting the job by arriving thirty minutes late for the interview.
senses.example_zh: 他面試遲到三十分鐘，搞砸了得到那份工作的機會。

gsat.sentence: Peter’s sudden death was a great [[blow]] to Jane and it took her a long time to get over the grief.

senses.en: something that a person has a duty to handle
senses.pattern: make it your business to / none of your business / have no business doing
senses.example: It is a teacher's [[business]] to make sure that every student feels safe in class.
senses.example_zh: 確保每位學生在課堂上感到安全，是老師分內的事。

senses.en: a matter, event, or situation, often a troublesome one
senses.pattern: the whole business / a strange business / an unpleasant business
senses.example: The whole [[business]] of applying for a visa took far longer than we had expected.
senses.example_zh: 申請簽證這整件事情花的時間比我們預期的久得多。

senses.en: a public demand or request for something to happen
senses.pattern: calls for reform / a call for help / a call to action
senses.example: After the accident, parents made repeated [[calls]] for stricter safety checks on school buses.
senses.example_zh: 事故發生後，家長一再呼籲對校車進行更嚴格的安全檢查。
senses.note: 動詞片語 call for＝呼籲；需要

senses.en: to announce that a meeting, election, or strike will happen
senses.pattern: call a meeting / call an election / call a strike
senses.example: The principal [[called]] an urgent meeting to discuss how to keep students safe during the typhoon.
senses.example_zh: 校長召開緊急會議，討論颱風期間如何確保學生安全。

gsat.sentence: The recent cooking oil scandals have led to [[calls]] for tougher regulation of sales of food products.

senses.en: having no record of crime or wrongdoing
senses.pattern: a clean record / a clean driving record
senses.example: Because he had a [[clean]] record, the judge let him off with only a warning.
senses.example_zh: 由於他紀錄清白，法官只給了警告就放過他。

senses.en: fair and following the rules
senses.pattern: a clean game / a clean fight / clean competition
senses.example: Both coaches praised the players for a [[clean]] game with no fouls or arguments.
senses.example_zh: 兩隊教練都稱讚球員打了一場守規則的比賽，沒有犯規也沒有爭執。

senses.en: a single book or newspaper among many printed
senses.pattern: a copy of the book / sell a million copies / a signed copy / a free copy
senses.example: The novel sold over two million [[copies]] in its first year and was later made into a film.
senses.example_zh: 這本小說第一年就賣出超過兩百萬本，後來還被改編成電影。

senses.en: written text for an advertisement or a newspaper
senses.pattern: write copy / advertising copy / edit copy
senses.example: She writes advertising [[copy]] for a shoe company, trying to make every sentence short and catchy.
senses.example_zh: 她替一家鞋業公司寫廣告文案，力求每個句子都簡短又吸睛。

gsat.sentence: So, grab a [[copy]] and start learning how you can reduce stress in your life.

senses.en: to have existed since a particular time
senses.pattern: date back to the 12th century / date from 1850 / date back centuries
senses.example: The stone bridge in the village [[dates]] back to the Roman period and is still used today.
senses.example_zh: 村裡的這座石橋可追溯至羅馬時期，至今仍在使用。

senses.en: to work out how old something is
senses.pattern: date a fossil / date the painting to 1600 / carbon dating
senses.example: Scientists [[dated]] the bones to about thirty thousand years ago by measuring the carbon they contained.
senses.example_zh: 科學家測量骨頭中的碳含量，鑑定出其年代約為三萬年前。

gsat.sentence: In fact, there is documented reference to the ringing of bells even before the cathedral’s construction was completed, [[dating]] as far back as the 12th century.
The idea of Blue Monday [[dates]] back to a 2005 campaign by Sky Travel.

senses.en: the lowest part of something
senses.pattern: at the foot of the mountain / the foot of the stairs / the foot of the page / the foot of the bed
senses.example: Please sign your name at the [[foot]] of the page before you hand in the form.
senses.example_zh: 繳交表格前，請在頁面底部簽上你的名字。
senses.note: at the foot of the mountain＝在山腳

senses.en: to pay a bill, especially a large one
senses.pattern: foot the bill / foot the bill for / foot the cost
senses.example: When the old bridge collapsed, taxpayers had to [[foot]] the bill for building a new one.
senses.example_zh: 舊橋倒塌後，興建新橋的費用只得由納稅人支付。
senses.note: 幾乎只用於 foot the bill

senses.en: because (used in formal writing)
senses.pattern: …, for it was getting dark / …, for he had no choice
senses.example: The villagers decided to leave at once, [[for]] the river was rising faster than expected.
senses.example_zh: 村民決定立刻離開，因為河水上漲得比預期還快。
senses.note: 書面語；前有逗號，不置於句首

senses.en: considering what is normal for someone or something
senses.pattern: tall for his age / warm for January / not bad for a beginner
senses.example: Your little brother is remarkably tall [[for]] his age; he looks like a junior high student.
senses.example_zh: 就他的年齡而言，你弟弟長得特別高，看起來像個國中生。

senses.en: in support of or in favor of
senses.pattern: be for the plan / for or against / vote for the proposal / be all for it
senses.example: Are you [[for]] or against the proposal to start school one hour later?
senses.example_zh: 你贊成還是反對把上學時間延後一小時的提案？

gsat.sentence: Brahma thought for a long time and finally decided to hide their divinity in the center of their own being, for humans would never think to look [[for]] it there.

senses.en: strange and not familiar to someone
senses.pattern: be foreign to someone / a foreign concept / feel completely foreign
senses.example: Mountain life was [[foreign]] to the city children, who had never seen a night sky full of stars.
senses.example_zh: 山上的生活對這群城市孩子來說很陌生，他們從沒看過滿天星斗的夜空。

senses.en: having entered something by accident and not belonging there
senses.pattern: a foreign object / a foreign body / foreign matter / a foreign substance
senses.example: Tears help wash away dust and other [[foreign]] objects that get into our eyes.
senses.example_zh: 眼淚有助於沖走跑進眼睛的灰塵和其他外來的異物。

gsat.sentence: Without much contact with the outside world for many years, John found many technological inventions [[foreign]] to him.

senses.en: to move very slowly and carefully
senses.pattern: inch forward / inch along / inch toward the door
senses.example: The line was so long that we [[inched]] toward the ticket window for almost an hour.
senses.example_zh: 隊伍排得太長，我們朝售票窗口緩慢移動了將近一小時。

senses.en: fair and morally right
senses.pattern: a just society / a just cause / a just decision / a just reward
senses.example: Most villagers agreed that the fine was a [[just]] punishment for dumping waste into the river.
senses.example_zh: 大多數村民都認為，這筆罰款是對往河裡傾倒廢棄物的公正懲罰。
senses.note: 名詞 justice＝正義；反義 unjust

senses.en: a set of musical notes based on one note
senses.pattern: in the key of C / a major key / a minor key / sing off key
senses.example: The song was too high for the choir, so the teacher played it in a lower [[key]].
senses.example_zh: 這首歌對合唱團來說太高了，所以老師改用較低的調來彈。

senses.en: a list of answers or explanations of symbols
senses.pattern: an answer key / a map key / the key to the exercises
senses.example: Check your answers against the [[key]] at the back of the workbook after you finish each exercise.
senses.example_zh: 每做完一個練習，就對照習作後面的解答核對答案。

senses.en: to find out a piece of news or information
senses.pattern: learn of the news / learn about the accident / learn that / be sorry to learn
senses.example: We were shocked to [[learn]] that our favorite teacher would retire at the end of June.
senses.example_zh: 得知我們最喜歡的老師將在六月底退休，大家都很震驚。
senses.note: learn of / about＋名詞；learn that＋子句

gsat.sentence: I’ve just [[learned]] that I’ll die very soon and I’m going to be reborn as a pig.

senses.en: the exact words of a rule, not its spirit
senses.pattern: the letter of the law / to the letter / follow instructions to the letter
senses.example: The company obeyed the [[letter]] of the law but ignored its real purpose of protecting workers.
senses.example_zh: 這家公司遵守了法律條文的字面意義，卻忽視了保護勞工的真正用意。
senses.note: to the letter＝不折不扣地、嚴格地

senses.en: unkind to others; unwilling to spend money
senses.pattern: be mean to somebody / a mean trick / mean with money
senses.example: It was [[mean]] of you to laugh at him when he dropped his lunch tray.
senses.example_zh: 他把午餐托盤打翻時你還笑他，真是太刻薄了。

senses.en: to intend something; to design for a purpose
senses.pattern: mean to do something / be meant to / be meant for
senses.example: I didn't [[mean]] to wake you; I was only looking for my keys.
senses.example_zh: 我不是有意要吵醒你，我只是在找鑰匙。
senses.note: be meant to 表「目的是、應該」

senses.en: the average of a set of numbers
senses.pattern: calculate the mean / the mean of the scores / above the mean
senses.example: To find the [[mean]], add up all the scores and divide by the number of students.
senses.example_zh: 要算出平均數，就把所有分數加起來，再除以學生人數。

gsat.sentence: The new manager is a real gentleman. He is kind and humble, totally different from the former manager, who was [[mean]] and bossy.
It is [[meant]] to be an enjoyable dining experience that can span hours.

senses.en: the study and practice of treating illness
senses.pattern: study medicine / practice medicine / modern medicine / traditional Chinese medicine
senses.example: After studying [[medicine]] for seven years, Kevin finally became a doctor at a children's hospital.
senses.example_zh: 攻讀醫學七年後，凱文終於成為兒童醫院的醫師。

gsat.sentence: There are three branches of [[medicine]].
Jonathan had qualified as a doctor but later gave up the practice of [[medicine]] for full-time writing.

senses.en: to get as much money or advantage as possible
senses.pattern: milk the situation / milk sb for money / milk sth for all it's worth
senses.example: The film studio has [[milked]] the popular series for years by releasing one weak sequel after another.
senses.example_zh: 這家電影公司多年來不斷推出乏善可陳的續集，藉此榨取這個熱門系列的價值。

senses.en: to take milk from a cow or goat
senses.pattern: milk the cows / milk a goat / a milking machine
senses.example: On the school farm trip, each student learned to [[milk]] a goat by hand.
senses.example_zh: 在學校的農場之旅中，每位學生都學會了用手替山羊擠奶。

senses.en: a group of people sent abroad for official work
senses.pattern: a trade mission / a diplomatic mission / a medical mission
senses.example: A trade [[mission]] of thirty business leaders visited Vietnam to look for new partners.
senses.example_zh: 一個由三十位企業領袖組成的貿易代表團訪問越南，尋找新的合作夥伴。

senses.en: a religious group or place doing work to spread a faith
senses.pattern: a mission school / a mission hospital / a Christian mission
senses.example: The doctor spent ten years at a Christian [[mission]] in the mountains, treating villagers for free.
senses.example_zh: 這位醫師在山區一處基督教傳教機構待了十年，免費替村民看病。

senses.en: to choose someone for a job, position, or honor
senses.pattern: be named captain / name sb as manager / be named player of the year
senses.example: After leading the team to three straight victories, Tina was [[named]] captain of the school volleyball team.
senses.example_zh: 帶領球隊三連勝後，蒂娜被任命為學校排球隊的隊長。

senses.en: a reputation; the opinion people have of someone
senses.pattern: make a name for oneself / a good name / a big name
senses.example: The young chef has made a [[name]] for herself with creative dishes using local vegetables.
senses.example_zh: 這位年輕主廚以運用在地蔬菜的創意料理闖出了名聲。

gsat.sentence: Skilled at drawing, he soon made a [[name]] for himself making illustrations for novels, sheet music, magazines, and children’s books.

senses.en: a group of hunting animals or of similar people
senses.pattern: a pack of wolves / a pack of dogs / hunt in packs / the leader of the pack
senses.example: A [[pack]] of wolves was seen crossing the frozen lake early yesterday morning.
senses.example_zh: 昨天清晨有人看見一群狼越過結冰的湖面。

senses.en: to fill a place completely with people or things
senses.pattern: pack the stadium / pack the streets / be packed with
senses.example: More than fifty thousand fans [[packed]] the stadium to watch the final game of the season.
senses.example_zh: 超過五萬名球迷擠滿了體育場，觀看本季最後一場比賽。

gsat.sentence: As the children grow, they run around the village in a [[pack]], wearing identical clothing and hairstyles, staring at everyone impolitely.

senses.en: favorite; especially liked or cared about
senses.pattern: a pet project / a pet subject / a pet theory / a pet peeve
senses.example: Building a small library for the village children has long been the mayor's [[pet]] project.
senses.example_zh: 為村裡的孩子蓋一座小圖書館，一直是鎮長最熱衷的計畫。

senses.en: to touch an animal gently with your hand
senses.pattern: pet a dog / pet the cat / pet an animal gently
senses.example: The little girl gently [[petted]] the rabbit until it fell asleep in her arms.
senses.example_zh: 小女孩輕輕撫摸著兔子，直到牠在她懷裡睡著。

senses.en: to take money for yourself, especially dishonestly
senses.pattern: pocket the money / pocket the difference / pocket the profits
senses.example: The dishonest clerk charged customers extra and [[pocketed]] the difference for nearly a year.
senses.example_zh: 那名不誠實的店員向顧客多收錢，並侵吞差額將近一年。

senses.en: a small area different from what surrounds it
senses.pattern: pockets of poverty / a pocket of air / isolated pockets
senses.example: Most of the city has recovered from the flood, but small [[pockets]] of damage remain near the river.
senses.example_zh: 城市大部分地區已從水災中復原，但河邊仍有零星受損的小區域。

senses.en: to mention something for discussion; to cause doubts
senses.pattern: raise a question / raise an issue / raise concerns / raise doubts
senses.example: Several students [[raised]] the issue of heavy homework at the meeting with the principal.
senses.example_zh: 幾位學生在與校長的會議上提出了作業太多的問題。

senses.en: to collect money for a particular purpose
senses.pattern: raise money / raise funds for charity / raise capital
senses.example: The club sold handmade cookies to [[raise]] money for the local animal shelter.
senses.example_zh: 社團販售手工餅乾，為當地的動物收容所籌募資金。

senses.en: an increase in the money you are paid
senses.pattern: get a raise / ask for a raise / a pay raise
senses.example: After two years of hard work, she finally asked her boss for a [[raise]].
senses.example_zh: 努力工作兩年後，她終於向老闆要求加薪。

gsat.sentence: Deadly shootings on US campuses have [[raised]] grave concerns about how to prevent such tragic incidents from happening again.
Amy succeeded in negotiating for a [[raise]] though her boss didn’t agree to increase her salary at first.

senses.en: a strong metal box with a lock for valuables
senses.pattern: a hotel safe / lock sth in a safe / open a safe / a fireproof safe
senses.example: Grandpa keeps the family's important documents in a small [[safe]] hidden behind a painting.
senses.example_zh: 爺爺把家裡的重要文件收在一個藏在畫後面的小保險箱裡。

gsat.sentence: soon to replace coding bank [[safes]].

senses.en: to shock someone or make a belief less strong
senses.pattern: be shaken by the news / shake one's confidence / shake one's faith
senses.example: The team's confidence was badly [[shaken]] after they lost three games in a row.
senses.example_zh: 連輸三場比賽後，這支球隊的信心嚴重動搖。
senses.note: 三態 shake–shook–shaken；shake up＝徹底改變

senses.en: a cold drink of milk, ice cream, and flavoring
senses.pattern: a chocolate shake / a strawberry shake / a protein shake / order a shake
senses.example: After practice, the boys each ordered a burger and a large chocolate [[shake]].
senses.example_zh: 練習結束後，男孩們各點了一個漢堡和一大杯巧克力奶昔。

senses.en: something seen, or a place worth seeing
senses.pattern: see the sights / a common sight / a familiar sight / tourist sights
senses.example: We spent our first day in Rome seeing the [[sights]], including the ancient stadium.
senses.example_zh: 我們在羅馬的第一天都在參觀名勝，包括那座古老的競技場。
senses.note: 作「名勝」解時用複數 sights

senses.en: to suddenly see something, especially something looked for
senses.pattern: sight land / sight a whale / be sighted off the coast
senses.example: After weeks at sea, the sailors finally [[sighted]] land on the horizon.
senses.example_zh: 在海上航行數週後，水手們終於看見了地平線上的陸地。

gsat.sentence: For two weeks he filled his sketchbook with the landscape’s most stunning [[sights]].
Street pigeons are a common [[sight]] in many European cities.

senses.en: very small in amount or chance
senses.pattern: a slim chance / slim hopes / a slim margin / a slim majority
senses.example: The home team won by a [[slim]] margin, scoring the only goal in the last minute.
senses.example_zh: 地主隊以微小的差距獲勝，在最後一分鐘踢進全場唯一的一球。

senses.en: to arrange things with regular gaps between them
senses.pattern: be evenly spaced / space sth out / be widely spaced / be spaced one meter apart
senses.example: During the exam, the desks were [[spaced]] one meter apart so that no one could look at another's paper.
senses.example_zh: 考試時，課桌以一公尺的間隔排列，讓大家無法偷看別人的考卷。

senses.en: a period of time
senses.pattern: in the space of an hour / within a short space of time / in the space of three years
senses.example: In the [[space]] of ten years, the quiet fishing village grew into a busy tourist town.
senses.example_zh: 在短短十年的時間內，這個寧靜的漁村發展成了熱鬧的觀光小鎮。
senses.note: 常用 in the space of＋時間

senses.en: to play, or to have someone as, the main performer
senses.pattern: star in a film / a film starring / star as / star alongside
senses.example: She [[starred]] in a popular TV drama at sixteen and became famous almost overnight.
senses.example_zh: 她十六歲時主演一部熱門電視劇，幾乎一夜成名。
senses.note: star in＋作品；a film starring＋演員

senses.en: to move suddenly because of surprise or fear
senses.pattern: start at the noise / start in surprise / start from one's sleep
senses.example: Lost in her book, Amy [[started]] when someone suddenly tapped her on the shoulder.
senses.example_zh: 艾咪看書看得入神，有人突然拍她肩膀時，她嚇了一跳。

senses.en: a sudden movement caused by surprise or fear
senses.pattern: wake with a start / give sb a start / sit up with a start
senses.example: I woke with a [[start]] at three in the morning, sure that I had heard footsteps downstairs.
senses.example_zh: 凌晨三點我猛然驚醒，確信自己聽到樓下有腳步聲。

senses.en: to keep something for future use
senses.pattern: store food / store data / store energy / store sth in a cool place
senses.example: Camels [[store]] fat in their humps, which helps them survive long journeys across the desert.
senses.example_zh: 駱駝把脂肪儲存在駝峰裡，這有助於牠們熬過橫越沙漠的長途旅程。

senses.en: a supply of something kept for use when needed
senses.pattern: a store of food / a store of knowledge / a store of energy
senses.example: Squirrels build up a large [[store]] of nuts in autumn to get through the winter.
senses.example_zh: 松鼠在秋天累積大量的堅果儲備，以度過冬天。

gsat.sentence: According to the passage, what is the best way to [[store]] olive oil?
Olive oil spoils quickly when exposed to direct sunlight, so it should be [[stored]] in the dark at 16-18°C.

senses.en: a floor or level of a building
senses.pattern: a two-story house / a ten-story building / the top story
senses.example: The fire started on the third [[story]] of the building and spread quickly to the roof.
senses.example_zh: 火勢從這棟大樓的第三層樓竄起，並迅速蔓延到屋頂。

senses.en: a report in a newspaper or news broadcast
senses.pattern: a news story / a front-page story / cover a story / run a story
senses.example: The reporter flew to the island to cover a [[story]] about the damage caused by the typhoon.
senses.example_zh: 記者飛往那座島，採訪一則有關颱風災情的新聞報導。

senses.en: to look carefully at the whole of something
senses.pattern: survey the scene / survey the damage / survey the crowd
senses.example: From the top of the tower, we [[surveyed]] the whole valley spread out below us.
senses.example_zh: 我們從塔頂眺望在腳下展開的整座山谷。

senses.en: to measure and record the details of land
senses.pattern: survey the land / survey a site / survey the coastline
senses.example: Engineers [[surveyed]] the hillside carefully before deciding where the new bridge should be built.
senses.example_zh: 工程師仔細勘測了山坡，才決定新橋該建在哪裡。

gsat.sentence: Sullivan, while [[surveying]] a campground, felt that a cloud was coming after him, and tried all he could to run—but it got him anyway.

senses.en: to know or recognize something, or see a difference
senses.pattern: tell A from B / tell the difference / can tell that / tell A and B apart
senses.example: The twins look so alike that even their teachers cannot [[tell]] one from the other.
senses.example_zh: 這對雙胞胎長得太像，連老師都無法分辨誰是誰。
senses.note: 常與 can / could 連用

senses.en: to have a noticeable, often harmful, effect
senses.pattern: tell on sb / begin to tell / the strain tells on sb
senses.example: After three weeks of exams, the lack of sleep was beginning to [[tell]] on the students.
senses.example_zh: 考了三個星期的試之後，睡眠不足開始對學生產生明顯影響。

gsat.sentence: It is easy for us to [[tell]] our friends from our enemies.

senses.en: a strong connection between people, groups, or countries
senses.pattern: close ties / family ties / strengthen ties with sb / cut ties
senses.example: Strong family [[ties]] kept the three brothers in touch even after they moved to different countries.
senses.example_zh: 緊密的家庭關係讓三兄弟即使移居不同國家，仍一直保持聯絡。

senses.en: a result in which both sides have equal scores
senses.pattern: end in a tie / a tie for first place / break a tie
senses.example: The final match ended in a [[tie]], so both teams shared the trophy.
senses.example_zh: 決賽以平手收場，因此兩隊共享獎盃。
senses.note: 動詞 tie 指「打成平手」

gsat.sentence: We are more than willing to strengthen our [[ties]] with those countries that are friendly to us.

senses.en: to be losing in a game or contest
senses.pattern: trail by two points / trail the leader / trail 0–2 / trail in the polls
senses.example: With only one lap left, the young runner still [[trailed]] the leader by three seconds.
senses.example_zh: 只剩最後一圈時，那位年輕跑者仍落後領先者三秒。
senses.note: 亦指拖曳、跟在後面：trail behind

senses.en: a series of marks or signs left behind
senses.pattern: leave a trail / a trail of blood / follow a trail / on the trail of
senses.example: The puppy ran through the house, leaving a [[trail]] of muddy footprints on the floor.
senses.example_zh: 小狗跑過屋子，在地板上留下一道泥腳印的痕跡。

gsat.sentence: They travel entirely along tree branches and vines, laying down [[trails]] of pheromone (a chemical substance) behind them so that other ants can follow.

senses.en: to examine a person or case in a court
senses.pattern: be tried for theft / try a case / be tried in court
senses.example: The two men were [[tried]] for robbery and sentenced to five years in prison.
senses.example_zh: 這兩名男子因搶劫罪受到審判，並被判處五年徒刑。

senses.en: to test someone's patience to the limit
senses.pattern: try sb's patience / try sb's nerves / be sorely tried
senses.example: The endless delays at the airport really [[tried]] the patience of the tired passengers.
senses.example_zh: 機場沒完沒了的延誤，著實考驗著疲憊旅客的耐心。

senses.en: to treat or judge someone unfairly
senses.pattern: wrong sb / feel wronged / be deeply wronged
senses.example: She felt deeply [[wronged]] when her classmates accused her of cheating on the test.
senses.example_zh: 同學指控她考試作弊，讓她覺得深受冤枉。

senses.en: an unjust, dishonest, or immoral act
senses.pattern: right a wrong / do sb wrong / know right from wrong
senses.example: The king promised to right the [[wrongs]] that his soldiers had done to the villagers.
senses.example_zh: 國王承諾要彌補他的士兵對村民所做的不義之事。

gsat.sentence: Once the [[wrong]] was made right, the pole was taken down.
To teach children right from [[wrong]], some parents will reward their children when they behave well and punish them when they misbehave.

senses.en: the babies of an animal
senses.pattern: feed their young / protect its young / raise their young
senses.example: A mother bear will attack anything that comes between her and her [[young]].
senses.example_zh: 母熊會攻擊任何擋在牠和幼熊之間的東西。
senses.note: 集合名詞，視為複數，不加 -s

quiz.stem: The vet admitted that the chances of saving the badly injured eagle were ______, but the volunteers refused to give up and fed it every two hours.
quiz.explain_zh: slim＝渺茫的。獸醫坦言救活老鷹的機會渺茫，但志工不放棄。

quiz.stem: The death of thousands of fish in the river has prompted growing ______ for the factory upstream to be shut down.
quiz.explain_zh: call＝呼籲、要求。河中大量魚群死亡，要求關閉上游工廠的呼聲越來越高。

quiz.stem: Though ______ by two goals at halftime, the home team refused to give up and scored three times in the final fifteen minutes.
quiz.explain_zh: trail＝（比賽中）落後。主隊中場落後兩球，最後十五分鐘連進三球逆轉。

quiz.stem: The two cities have maintained close cultural ______ for decades, exchanging students and holding a joint music festival every summer.
quiz.explain_zh: tie＝關係、聯繫。兩座城市數十年來維持密切的文化關係。

quiz.stem: A ______ society, the speaker argued, is one in which all children, rich or poor, have an equal chance to receive a good education.
quiz.explain_zh: just＝公正的。講者主張公正的社會應讓所有孩子都有平等的受教機會。

quiz.stem: Having relied on a smartphone since childhood, Amy admits that reading a paper map feels completely ______ to her.
quiz.explain_zh: foreign＝陌生的。從小依賴手機的艾咪，對看紙本地圖感到十分陌生。

quiz.stem: When the school trip was canceled because of the typhoon, the travel agency agreed to ______ the bill for the hotel rooms that had already been booked.
quiz.explain_zh: foot＝支付（帳單）。旅行社同意負擔已訂飯店房間的費用。

quiz.stem: Because of an accident ahead, the cars on the highway could only ______ forward, and it took us two hours to travel five kilometers.
quiz.explain_zh: inch＝緩慢移動。前方發生事故，車輛只能緩慢前進，五公里開了兩小時。

quiz.stem: Thanks to her outstanding leadership at last year's science fair, Ms. Lin was ______ head of the school's new research program.
quiz.explain_zh: name＝任命。林老師因領導能力出色，被任命為新研究計畫的負責人。

quiz.stem: The sudden closing of the town's only factory dealt a serious ______ to local families, many of whom had worked there for decades.
quiz.explain_zh: blow＝打擊、挫折。鎮上唯一的工廠突然關閉，對當地家庭是重大打擊。
